summary: Implemented both bug fixes: replaced O(n^2) dependency lookups with prebuilt step-id Maps in findRunnableSteps (execution-status.ts) and findRunnableTasks (agent-executor.ts), and synchronized orderedSteps by pushing the new system-polish step when it is appended to plan.steps. Verification passed: pnpm build, pnpm vitest run src/goal/, and focused regression test pnpm vitest run src/goal/agent-executor.test.ts -t "blocks on final build gate failure without mutating done step status". Note: pnpm lint currently fails on pre-existing unused imports in src/telegram/goal-commands.ts unrelated to this task.
